note: Karayol et al. (2024) describe a 25-patient cohort where vision problems and strabismus occur at lower/moderate penetrance.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 25 individuals with heterozygous de novo MSL2 variants, vision problems, along with seizures, connective tissue signs, and sleep disturbance, were reported to occur to a lesser extent than primary neurodevelopmental delays.

source.title: MSL2 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with lack of coordination, epilepsy, specific dysmorphisms, and a distinct episignature
source.quote: Dysmorphisms and behavioral and/or psychiatric conditions, including autism spectrum disorder, and to a lesser extent, seizures, connective tissue disease signs, sleep disturbance, vision problems, and other organ anomalies, were observed in affected individuals.
